# The allowed (caller -> socket) pairs of the local installation's deny matrix, the oracle that does not come from the
# guard's own function (tests/deny, REQ-ISO-090). Every pair below must reach its callee past the guard, and every other
# pair of the sweep must be refused. A change of the actor registry or of the Compose project that changes the call
# graph changes this list, and the pull request that makes it updates the list on purpose, where a reviewer sees it.
# The socket names are the ids of tests/deny/internal/spec (the numbered list of the report).
# A row is a uid with the groups of one unit: a caller's registry name, or the service of a unit that borrows a caller's
# uid with fewer groups (the borrowers of tests/deny/internal/spec). entry-audit, entry's audit front, reaches the spool
# alone; idp-loopback, which runs as the adapter's uid, reaches nothing and has no line.
adapter-upstream-oidc -> key/adapter-upstream-oidc
adapter-upstream-oidc -> policy
adapter-upstream-oidc -> spool-emit
adapter-upstream-oidc -> store
entry -> adapter
entry -> key/entry
entry -> spool-emit
entry -> store
entry-audit -> spool-emit
exchange -> adapter
exchange -> key/exchange
exchange -> policy
exchange -> signer
exchange -> spool-emit
exchange -> store
exporter -> drv-exporter
exporter -> key/exporter
exporter -> policy
exporter -> spool-emit
exporter -> store
harness-forwarder -> entry
indexer -> key/indexer
indexer -> policy
indexer -> spool-emit
indexer -> store
key -> drv-key
key -> spool-emit
key -> store
policy -> key/policy
policy -> spool-emit
policy -> store
reader -> key/reader
reader -> policy
reader -> spool-emit
reader -> store
session -> adapter
session -> key/session
session -> policy
session -> signer
session -> spool-emit
session -> store
signer -> key/signer
signer -> spool-emit
signer -> store
store -> drv-config
store -> drv-durable
store -> drv-secret
store -> drv-temp
store -> key/store
store -> spool-emit
writer -> drv-blob
writer -> key/writer
writer -> policy
writer -> spool-emit
writer -> spool-receive
writer -> store
